ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with localized high-intensity (white) regions; estimated macro-level ratio of approximately 1:18 high-to-low intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity black base across the visible surface; distinct high-contrast white circular ring blobs located in the mid-left and center-ventral coordinates; white linear streaks mapped to the mid-left and distal-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 118 degrees and shallow vertical depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (jagged peaks) extracted along the continuous trailing edge from notch to distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve following a convex trajectory from the median notch with an increasing upward sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 12 high-contrast white circular ring clusters, concentrated in the medial region of the left lobe and scattered on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions, including a prominent diagonal mark on the mid-left lobe and a steep diagonal mark on the far-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of multi-faceted, high-intensity calcified structures (barnacles) localized on the distal tips of both lobes; extensive circular and linear scarring present across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme barnacle colonization density concentrated exclusively on the outermost 10% of the lateral fluke margins.
